summary: Completed comprehensive bug verification testing for 3 reported bugs. All 3 bugs have been FIXED and verified working.

bug_1_mealprep_portions.description: Meal Prep page - 'Nx this week' frequency should match 'Cook N portions'
bug_1_mealprep_portions.evidence: Tested with 9 recipes: 5x=Cook 5, 5x=Cook 5, 4x=Cook 4, 3x=Cook 3, 3x=Cook 3, 2x=Cook 2, 2x=Cook 2, 2x=Cook 2, 2x=Cook 2. All frequencies match portion counts.
bug_1_mealprep_portions.fix_description: Changed totalPortions calculation from Math.ceil(item.total_servings) to item.frequency

bug_2_modal_scroll.description: Recipe modal should be scrollable when content exceeds viewport
bug_2_modal_scroll.evidence: Modal uses Radix ScrollArea component with overflow-y-auto. Tested on Recipes page, Dashboard, and MealPrep page modals. ScrollArea viewport properly implemented.
bug_2_modal_scroll.fix_description: Added overflow-hidden and overflow-y-auto to all modals with ScrollArea component

bug_3_recipe_images.description: Recipe images missing from UI (cards and modals)
bug_3_recipe_images.evidence: Found 39 visible recipe card images on Recipes page. All images loading from Unsplash URLs. Modal images also displaying correctly (tested Greek Yogurt Parfait, Seitan Stir-Fry, Protein-Packed Overnight Oats).
bug_3_recipe_images.fix_description: Added image display in recipe cards and modals. Backend already had image_url in seed recipes.

screenshots_captured: .screenshots/bug1_mealprep.png - Meal Prep page showing frequency/portions match

test_credentials.note: New test user created for each test run

seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing SEED_RECIPES with image_url fields
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 reported bugs have been verified as fixed. Bug 1 (MealPrep portions) now correctly uses item.frequency instead of Math.ceil(item.total_servings). Bug 2 (modal scroll) uses Radix ScrollArea component. Bug 3 (images) now displays Unsplash URLs from backend SEED_RECIPES. Sessions expire between browser automation calls - use single script for full E2E tests.
